title: Anthropic Signs All Internal Token Traffic to Verify Model Weights
summary:
A new tool for confirming the origin of AI outputs is now being tested at Anthropic. The company has created a prototype that verifies whether model outputs originate from a specific set of weights and has implemented digital signing for all its internal token traffic.

These developments were detailed in the Moonshot R&D projects section of the company's Frontier Safety Roadmap. Although the updates were initially overlooked, some industry observers have since called the new verification and signing systems a big deal for AI safety.
